record.cardDesc: Record your actions for Agent reference
record.sectionHint: Generates a recording instruction — send it to your Agent to start recording your actions; the Agent can then use the resulting trace bundle to automate similar tasks.
record.promptTemplate:
Use BrowserSkill's `bsk` CLI to record the browser actions I'm about to demonstrate.

Steps:
1. Run: {{command}}
2. Once you confirm it's started, I'll operate in the opened window myself.
3. After I click Finish, read the written `./trace` bundle (`trace.json` + `states/`) and summarize what I did.

audit.title: Operation audit
audit.partialDescription: Recording started at {{time}}. Paused intervals were not recorded; see the timeline below.
audit.empty: No tasks recorded yet. Future BrowserSkill operations will appear here.
audit.disconnected: The local service is disconnected. Start the BrowserSkill service and retry. Existing history remains on your computer.
audit.unsupported: This local service does not support operation auditing. Update bsk and retry.
audit.requestFailed: Could not read or save audit history. Check local storage and task availability, or retry after the task ends.
audit.privacyShort: Saved locally for 30 days. Input content is hidden.
audit.privacyFull: History stays on your computer. Finished tasks are kept for 30 days. Input bodies, scripts, page text, and URL paths and parameters are not saved. Target names receive basic redaction. Exports contain the same redacted records.
audit.resultNote: “Operation completed” means the tool call completed, not that the website confirmed a business outcome. Missing results are marked “Outcome unknown”.
audit.deleteConfirm: Delete this task’s local audit history? This cannot be undone.
